entries.title: Jeremiah 43:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Tahpanhes - It was at this time the place where the king of Egypt made his residence.

entries.title: Jeremiah 43:12
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Carry them - He shall carry away both the idols, and the inhabitants of Egypt captive. With the land - With the spoils of the land of Egypt, he shall clothe his army.

entries.title: Jeremiah 43:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Beth - shemesh - Beth - shemesh is the name of a city, which had its name from a famous temple of the sun.
